title: MEDTRUM / Empty reservoir when pod is deactivated
symptom: Minor Medtrum bug. No active pod but the tab says that there is still insulin available.
fix: Once the pod has been deactivated, the insulin in it is 'lost' and could be set to 0. Also reset pump battery and expiration date, but keep last bolus.
evidence_quote: I think that, once the pod has been deactivated, the insulin in it is "lost" and could be set to 0.
